def VTask.evenOddRec {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} (h0 : P 0) (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) (n : ℕ) : P n := by
  have h_main : P n := by
    have h₁ : ∀ n : ℕ, P n := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        match n with
        | 0 => exact h0
        | 1 =>
          -- Base case for n = 1
          have h₂ := h_odd 0 h0
          simpa using h₂
        | n + 2 =>
          -- Inductive step for n ≥ 2
          have h₂ := ih ((n + 2) / 2) (by
            have h₃ : (n + 2) / 2 < n + 2 := by
              apply Nat.div_lt_self
              <;> omega
            omega)
          have h₃ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 ∨ (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := by omega
          rcases h₃ with (h₃ | h₃)
          · -- Case (n + 2) % 2 = 0
            have h₄ : 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) = n + 2 := by
              have h₅ : (n + 2) % 2 = 0 := h₃
              omega
            have h₅ : P ((n + 2) / 2) := h₂
            have h₆ : P (2 * ((n + 2) / 2)) := h_even ((n + 2) / 2) h₅
            simpa [h₄] using h₆
          · -- Case (n + 2) % 2 = 1
            have h₄ : 2 * ((n + 2) / 2) + 1 = n + 2 := by
              have h₅ : (n + 2) % 2 = 1 := h₃
              omega
            have h₅ : P ((n + 2) / 2) := h₂
            have h₆ : P (2 * ((n + 2) / 2) + 1) := h_odd ((n + 2) / 2) h₅
            simpa [h₄] using h₆
    exact h₁ n
  exact h_main
